## FA-008 / ZEUS-4e7e2e2b01a9 revision 1 — Refs #9

### Defect (upstream, agreed in cross-review; root review requested changes)
`tech_stack._parse_yaml` does not strip inline comments, so the shipped template yields candidate paths such as `java                   # java | kotlin ...` and never `java/springboot-3.2` (`template-inline-comment-probe.json`, `expected_clean_path_present: false`). The root review added: the Flutter example activates `dart/...` rather than `flutter/3.x`, tree scanning is one level deep, and frontmatter-free modules are not scored independently.

### Zeus
- Inline comments: the project profile is loaded with the bounded string-only YAML loader and every routing value is validated as a path segment, so the upstream template shape routes cleanly and a quoted value containing `#` or spaces is rejected explicitly instead of becoming path text — now pinned by regression tests.
- **Changed** `eligible_paths`: `3.2` → also `3.x` (as `18` → `18.x`); `language: flutter, version: "3.24"` yields `flutter/flutter-3.24, flutter/flutter, flutter/3.24, flutter/3.x, flutter/lang, flutter` and no `dart/...`.
- **Changed** `select_skill_paths`: packaged `SKILL.md` collected at any depth below an eligible prefix; underscore-prefixed directories still skipped; other frameworks still excluded.
- Frontmatter-free modules are already selected by path; scoring only affects body/pointer tiers (unchanged).
- `docs/contracts.md`: `INV-PROJECT-001` sentence; `docs/zeus/implementation/stack-routing-001/README.md`.

### Verification
| | Result |
|---|---|
| `test_inline_comment_template_routes_to_clean_paths`, `test_flutter_stack_activates_the_flutter_tree_not_dart`, `test_comment_or_space_inside_a_quoted_value_fails_explicitly` (×3), `test_packaged_skills_are_collected_at_any_depth_and_underscore_directories_are_skipped` | pass |
| Negative control: revert `domain/project_skills.py` to `origin/main` | major-line and depth tests fail (3 of 6) |
| `test_project_skills`, `test_skill_routing`, `test_skill_guidance`, `test_pipeline` | 58 passed |
| Windows full `uv run pytest -q` (Python 3.12.14) / `ruff check` | 923 passed, 305 skipped / clean |
| Linux path | this PR's ubuntu CI matrix |

### Not claimed
Static routing regression only; actual Codex-session skill activation is covered by the existing fixture-runtime injection test, not re-measured here. The upstream Baldrix parser itself is not modified (ticket scope is limited to this repository; Zeus does not port that parser). Issue closure follows the ledger acceptance path (#30) and is a separate step after this PR; the GitHub issue stays OPEN until that acceptance.
